name: StreamerFun
summary:
StreamerFun is a browser-based multiplayer game platform designed for livestream communities. Streamers host interactive game sessions in which viewers join as players and compete in races, battles and other community challenges.

StreamerFun includes multiple game modes with their own rules, objectives and results. RaceXtreme lets up to 100 participants compete in an animated racing event featuring multiple lanes, overtaking, pit stops, lap timing and finishing positions. Other game modes provide different competitive and community-driven experiences.

Viewers can participate through livestream-integrated controls and commands. Player results and achievements can persist across game sessions, allowing participants to return and compete again in future livestreams.

StreamerFun is developed and published by Herpers Publishing International.
